versions.content: No variants in ICS A BSWMD that describes an actual product can contain variation points. But since the conformance tester gets fully con- figured object code, this means also, that the ICS-version of a BSWMD shall be free of any variation points, because the tester has no means to resolve the variants. If several variants of such a module shall be tested for conformance, for each variant a separate extract of the BSWMD (representing the ICS) plus object code shall be delivered to the tester
